name: alice-butler-pet
description: Alice desktop pet; file protocol compatible with AliceButler

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && esbuild src/renderer/effects-gpu.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --minify --outfile=dist/renderer/effects-gpu.js
scripts.test:effects: npm run build && node --test tests/effects.test.cjs tests/effects.integration.cjs
